items.source: name - the name of the cache
items.translation: name - 缓存的名称

items.source: the Spring CaffeineCache adapter (or a decorator thereof)
items.translation: Spring CaffeineCache 适配器（或其装饰器）

items.source: Note that any other caches, whether statically specified through setCacheNames(Collection) or dynamically built on demand, still operate with the common settings in the cache manager's configuration.
items.translation: 请注意，任何其他缓存，无论是通过 setCacheNames(Collection) 静态指定还是按需动态构建，仍然使用缓存管理器配置中的通用设置。

items.source: Set the CaffeineSpec to use for building each individual CaffeineCache instance.
items.translation: 设置用于构建每个单独的CaffeineCache实例的CaffeineSpec。

items.source: Adapt the given new Caffeine AsyncCache instance to Spring's Cache abstraction for the specified cache name.
items.translation: 将指定的缓存名称的给定新 Caffeine AsyncCache 实例适配为 Spring 的Cache抽象。

items.source: Adapt the given new native Caffeine Cache instance to Spring's Cache abstraction for the specified cache name.
items.translation: 为指定的缓存名称，将给定的新原生 Caffeine 缓存实例适配到 Spring 的Cache抽象。

items.source: Set the Caffeine CacheLoader to use for building each individual CaffeineCache instance, turning it into a LoadingCache.
items.translation: 设置用于构建每个单独的 CaffeineCache 实例的 Caffeine CacheLoader，将其转换为 LoadingCache。

items.source: Set the Caffeine to use for building each individual CaffeineCache instance.
items.translation: 设置用于构建每个单独的 CaffeineCache 实例的 Caffeine。

items.source: The configuration of the underlying cache can be fine-tuned through a Caffeine builder or CaffeineSpec, passed into this CacheManager through setCaffeine(Caffeine)/setCaffeineSpec(CaffeineSpec). A CaffeineSpec-compliant expression value can also be applied via the "cacheSpecification" bean property.
items.translation: 底层缓存的配置可以通过传入此 CacheManager 的 `Caffeine` 构建器或 `CaffeineSpec` 进行微调，具体通过 `setCaffeine(Caffeine)`/<`a href="#setCaffeineSpec(com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.CaffeineSpec)">setCaffeineSpec(CaffeineSpec) 实现。符合 `CaffeineSpec` 规范的表达式值也可以通过 `"cacheSpecification"` Bean 属性应用。

items.source: Supports the asynchronous Cache.retrieve(Object) and Cache.retrieve(Object, Supplier) operations through Caffeine's AsyncCache, when configured via setAsyncCacheMode(boolean), with early-determined cache misses.
items.translation: 支持通过 `setAsyncCacheMode(boolean)` 配置 Caffeine 的 `AsyncCache`，实现带有早期缓存未命中判断的异步 `Cache.retrieve(Object)` 和 `Cache.retrieve(Object, Supplier)` 操作。

items.source: Individual cache registrations (such as registerCustomCache(String, AsyncCache) and registerCustomCache(String, com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Cache)) are not dependent on this setting.
items.translation: 单个缓存注册（例如 registerCustomCache(String, AsyncCache) 和 registerCustomCache(String, com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Cache)）不依赖于此设置。

items.source: Note that this method replaces existing caches of the given names and prevents the creation of further cache regions from here on - but does not remove unrelated existing caches. For a full reset, consider calling resetCaches() before calling this method.
items.translation: 注意，此方法会替换给定名称的现有缓存，并从此阻止创建进一步的缓存区域，但不会删除不相关的现有缓存。若要完全重置，请在调用此方法之前考虑调用 resetCaches()。

items.source: This implicitly switches the "asyncCacheMode" flag to true.
items.translation: 这隐式地将"asyncCacheMode"标志切换为true。

items.source: By default, this cache manager builds regular native Caffeine caches. To switch to async caches which can also be used through the synchronous API but come with support for Cache#retrieve, set this flag to true.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此缓存管理器构建常规的本地 Caffeine 缓存。若要切换到异步缓存（这些缓存也可通过同步 API 使用，但支持 `Cache#retrieve`），请将此标志设置为 `true`。

items.source: Note that while null values in the cache are tolerated in async cache mode, the recommendation is to disallow null values through setAllowNullValues(false). This makes the semantics of CompletableFuture-based access simpler and optimizes retrieval performance since a Caffeine-provided CompletableFuture handle does not have to get wrapped.
items.translation: 请注意，虽然异步缓存模式允许缓存中存在 null 值，但建议通过setAllowNullValues(false)禁止 null 值。这使得基于 CompletableFuture 的访问语义更简单，并优化了检索性能，因为 Caffeine 提供的 CompletableFuture 句柄无需再进行包装。

items.source: If you come here for the adaptation of reactive types such as a Reactor Mono or Flux onto asynchronous caching, we recommend the standard arrangement for caching the produced values asynchronously in 6.1 through enabling this Caffeine mode. If this is not immediately possible/desirable for existing apps, you may set the system property "spring.cache.reactivestreams.ignore=true" to restore 6.0 behavior where reactive handles are treated as regular values.
items.translation: 如果您是为了将响应式类型（如 Reactor 的 `Mono` 或 `Flux`）适配到异步缓存而来到此处，我们建议通过启用此 Caffeine 模式来采用第 6.1 版中用于异步缓存生成值的标准方案。如果对于现有应用程序而言这并非立即可行或理想的选择，您可以设置系统属性 "spring.cache.reactivestreams.ignore=true"，以恢复将响应式句柄视为常规值的 6.0 行为。

items.source: Default is "true", despite Caffeine itself not supporting null values. An internal holder object will be used to store user-level nulls.
items.translation: 默认值为"true"，尽管 Caffeine 本身不支持null值。 将使用一个内部持有对象来存储用户级别的null值。

items.source: Delegates to adaptCaffeineCache(String, Cache) as the adaptation method to Spring's cache abstraction (allowing for centralized decoration etc.), passing in a freshly built native Caffeine Cache instance.
items.translation: 委托给 adaptCaffeineCache(String, Cache) 作为适配方法，以适配 Spring 的缓存抽象（允许集中式装饰等），并传入新构建的原生 Caffeine Cache 实例。

items.source: Calling this method with a null collection argument resets the mode to 'dynamic', allowing for further creation of caches again.
items.translation: 调用此方法并传入一个null集合参数会将模式重置为'dynamic'，从而允许再次创建缓存。

items.source: This allows for custom settings per cache (as opposed to all caches sharing the common settings in the cache manager's configuration) and is typically used with the Caffeine builder API: registerCustomCache("myCache", Caffeine.newBuilder().maximumSize(10).build())
items.translation: 这允许为每个缓存设置自定义配置（而不是所有缓存共享缓存管理器配置中的通用设置），通常与 Caffeine 构建器 API 一起使用： registerCustomCache("myCache", Caffeine.newBuilder().maximumSize(10).build())

items.source: This allows for custom settings per cache (as opposed to all caches sharing the common settings in the cache manager's configuration) and is typically used with the Caffeine builder API: registerCustomCache("myCache", Caffeine.newBuilder().maximumSize(10).buildAsync())
items.translation: 这允许为每个缓存设置自定义配置（而不是所有缓存共享缓存管理器配置中的通用设置），通常与 Caffeine 构建器 API 一起使用： registerCustomCache("myCache", Caffeine.newBuilder().maximumSize(10).buildAsync())

items.source:
The number of caches and their names will be fixed after a call
to this method, with no creation of further cache regions at runtime.
items.translation: 调用此方法后，缓存的数量及其名称将固定，运行时不会再创建新的缓存区域。

items.source: Set the Caffeine cache specification String to use for building each individual CaffeineCache instance. The given value needs to comply with Caffeine's CaffeineSpec (see its javadoc).
items.translation: 设置用于构建每个单独CaffeineCache实例的 Caffeine 缓存规范 String。给定值需要符合 Caffeine 的CaffeineSpec（参见其 javadoc）。

items.source: Build a common CaffeineCache instance for the specified cache name, using the common Caffeine configuration specified on this cache manager.
items.translation: 为指定的缓存名称构建一个通用的 CaffeineCache 实例，使用此缓存管理器中指定的通用 Caffeine 配置。

items.source: Register the given Caffeine AsyncCache instance with this cache manager, adapting it to Spring's cache API for exposure through getCache(String).
items.translation: 将给定的 Caffeine AsyncCache 实例注册到此缓存管理器中，将其适配为 Spring 的缓存 API，以便通过getCache(String)进行暴露。

items.source: Register the given native Caffeine Cache instance with this cache manager, adapting it to Spring's cache API for exposure through getCache(String).
items.translation: 将给定的原生 Caffeine 缓存实例注册到此缓存管理器中，并将其适配为 Spring 的缓存 API，以便通过getCache(String)进行暴露。

items.source: Set the Caffeine AsyncCacheLoader to use for building each individual CaffeineCache instance, turning it into a LoadingCache.
items.translation: 设置用于构建每个单独的 CaffeineCache 实例的 Caffeine AsyncCacheLoader，将其转换为 LoadingCache。

items.source: Set the Caffeine cache specification String to use for building each individual CaffeineCache instance.
items.translation: 设置用于构建每个单独的CaffeineCache实例的 Caffeine 缓存规格 String。

items.source: Return whether this cache manager accepts and converts null values for all of its caches.
items.translation: 返回此缓存管理器是否接受并转换其所有缓存中的 `null` 值。

items.source:
Construct a dynamic CaffeineCacheManager,
lazily creating cache instances as they are being requested.
items.translation: 构建动态的 CaffeineCacheManager，在请求时懒加载缓存实例。

items.source:
Construct a static CaffeineCacheManager,
managing caches for the specified cache names only.
items.translation: 构建一个静态的 CaffeineCacheManager，仅管理指定的缓存名称。

items.source:
Build a common Caffeine AsyncCache instance for the specified cache name,
using the common Caffeine configuration specified on this cache manager.
items.translation: 为指定的缓存名称构建一个通用的 Caffeine AsyncCache 实例，使用此缓存管理器上指定的通用 Caffeine 配置。

items.source:
Build a common Caffeine Cache instance for the specified cache name,
using the common Caffeine configuration specified on this cache manager.
items.translation: 为指定的缓存名称构建一个通用的 Caffeine 缓存实例，使用此缓存管理器上指定的通用 Caffeine 配置。

items.source: Get a collection of the cache names known by this manager.
items.translation: 获取此管理器已知的缓存名称集合。

items.source:
Remove the specified cache from this cache manager, applying to
custom caches as well as dynamically registered caches at runtime.
items.translation: 从此缓存管理器中移除指定的缓存，该操作同时适用于自定义缓存和运行时动态注册的缓存。

items.source:
Reset this cache manager's caches, removing them completely for on-demand
re-creation in 'dynamic' mode, or simply clearing their entries otherwise.
items.translation: 重置此缓存管理器的缓存，在“动态”模式下将其完全移除以便按需重新创建，否则则仅清除其条目。
